correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive enumerations agree on 6,497 augmented faces; all 29,160 Hasse incidences certify a 3,199-pair acyclic matching. Every integer signed Morse boundary is exactly zero on 99 critical faces of dimensions 3 through 6. Integral free groups of ranks 6,45,36,12 and vanishing elsewhere follow; unmatching the empty face proves 2-connectivity. Direct mod-two chain ranks check the resulting Betti numbers. Proof and executable reproduction are embedded.

value.rationale: The 3-cube is the natural first trivalent binary hypercube, equivalently the four-crown. Its fully bidirected multipath complex has a remarkable four consecutive nonzero integral homology dimensions; exact all-prime torsion-freeness and 2-connectivity provide a mathematically motivated, reproducible benchmark beyond the bidirected degree-two families. The natural invariant is fully computed without extrapolation or claiming unwarranted higher homotopy.
